key_insight: FrugalEvo shifts evolutionary program optimization from "maximize improvement in a fixed budget of steps" to "maximize improvement per dollar spent." It uses a strong model for high-level exploration and a cheaper model for implementation, aiming for better cost-efficiency without sacrificing search quality.
problem_solved: Existing LLM-guided evolutionary methods often focus on performance gains over a fixed number of iterations, ignoring the real-world cost of using large models. This paper addresses the need for practical, cost-aware optimization in computationally expensive tasks.
method: Use a stronger, higher-cost LLM to explore candidate solution strategies and propose promising evolutionary directions.
Use a cheaper LLM to carry out the actual implementation of those strategies, reducing overall inference cost.
Evaluate evolutionary progress with cost-awareness, prioritizing gain per unit cost rather than gain per iteration.
impact: For AI/ML practitioners, FrugalEvo offers a more practical way to deploy LLM-guided optimization in settings where budget matters. It is especially relevant for expensive search problems where smarter allocation of model capacity can improve efficiency and scalability.

paper_title: FrugalEvo: Towards Cost-Aware LLM-Guided Program Evolution
paper_authors: Hui Chen, Xuan Qi, James Xu Zhao, Zhaopeng Feng, Shilong Liu
